title: Sylvester matrix equation AX + XB = C
prompt:
Find the 4×4 matrix X that satisfies the matrix equation A·X + X·B = C, where

A =
[ -1   3   0   2 ]
[ -3   1   2  -3 ]
[  2  -2   3  -1 ]
[  1   2   4  -3 ]

B =
[  3  -4   1   1 ]
[  1  -1   2   3 ]
[  0  -1   0  -4 ]
[  3   2   3  -4 ]

C =
[  23  -37   -1  -10 ]
[   7   16   15  -26 ]
[  -4   20   26   -1 ]
[  -8   22   15   32 ]

(the solution is unique). Give the 16 entries of X row by row as exact numbers separated by commas.

Think it through, then finish with a final line of the form `ANSWER: <your answer>`.
